purpose: Frozen held-out cases for direct merchant relationships, independent repair/video merchants, name collisions, ambiguity, and untrusted instructions. Original acceptance cases remain unchanged.
expectations: Directly branded Google/YouTube Premium merchants belong to Alphabet; directly branded Tesla services belong to Tesla. Independent sellers and repairers do not inherit the ownership of products they mention.
